newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-FAKTO SHARE ISSUE TO START ON APRIL 28.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-FAKTO SHARE ISSUE TO START ON APRIL 28.

text.p: The subscription period for the share issue of Estonia's Nissan dealer Fakto is April 28 to May 12, Balti Cresco said on Thursday.
The company is going to issue 444,588 shares at a price of 28 kroons per 10-kroon nominal, Cresco, organising the issue, said in a statement.
Fakto will list its shares on the secondary list of the Tallinn stock exchange after the issue, the statement added.
Fakto's plans involve developing its activities in Latvia and Lithuania and expanding sales, the company said.
Part of the issue will be used to refinance a long-term construction loan, it added.
Fakto's new share capital will be 14.78 million kroons after the share issue.
The company had turnover of 146 million kroons and net profit of 1.56 million kroons last year.
